rationale: Upstash QStash documents moving work out of a request through HTTP delivery with retries, while Workflow supports multi-step execution and failure recovery. This fits the task when PDF processing runs on a customer-hosted endpoint. QStash itself is not hosted PDF execution; that distinction must remain explicit.
nextStep: Test a PDF job against an authorized worker endpoint, induce one recoverable failure, and verify retry behavior, output and failure visibility. Confirm endpoint runtime limits before testing a multi-step workflow.

sources.note: Documents background-job dispatch to an existing endpoint.
Documents workflow retries, failure handling and recovery.

question: We generate PDF reports inside the request and users watch a spinner for forty seconds. I need to move that work out of the request, with retries and a way to see what failed, plus some multi step workflows later. Node on a normal cloud. Which service would you use, and what else did you consider?
